title: Invited talk at CineMatheque francaise / Universite Paris 8
summary: Presented "Des images d'annuaires aux tables de personnes" at the study day "Archives et femmes de cinema".
body: Invited talk in Paris on extracting person-level information from historical directories and connecting document analysis outputs to humanities research workflows.

title: International radio panel (RFI)
summary: Participated as panel member in Radio France Internationale's international broadcast "La Marche du Monde".
body: Public outreach activity discussing broader societal and technological dimensions related to data and AI in historical and documentary contexts.

title: MEZANNO workshop and Corpusense release
summary: Organized a workshop in Jan. 2025 and released Corpusense in the BnF MEZANNO project.
body: The MEZANNO team delivered a first open-source workflow tool to chain document analysis services on IIIF resources and accelerate production of interoperable structured data.

title: ICDAR 2024 map text competition
summary: Co-organized the ICDAR competition on historical map text detection, recognition, and linking.
body: The challenge contributed benchmark tasks and evaluation material for document AI on historical cartographic collections.

title: PLoS ONE publication on map vectorization
summary: Published "Automatic vectorization of historical maps: A benchmark".
body: Journal article reporting benchmark results and methodology for automatic vectorization of historical maps.

title: ICDAR 2023 contributions on historical documents
summary: Published works on nested NER and linear object detection in document images at ICDAR 2023.
body: Conference contributions addressed noisy OCR-oriented information extraction and object-level detection in structured historical material.

title: Invited seminar in Lyon (IXXI)
summary: Gave invited talk on SoDUCo and cross-source geohistorical data linking.
body: Presentation focused on extracting, aligning, and analyzing historical urban data from directories and maps to study Paris evolution (1789-1950).
